author: mostafa_gawad
title: Hiring Vector Background Artists for Animated Series
content:
🎨 WE’RE HIRING! – VECTOR BACKGROUND ARTISTS
JUMP ANIMATION is looking for talented Vector Background Artists to join our upcoming animated series project!
Requirements: Strong skills in creating 2D vector backgrounds. Proficiency in Adobe Illustrator or Adobe Animate. Ability to match an established cartoon art style. Attention to detail and good artistic skills.
Project Duration: 2–3 Months (Freelance).
📩 Send your CV and Portfolio to: jobs@jumpanimation.com or gawad26@gmail.com. You can also message us directly through Facebook!

author: whenthesilentbirdsings
title: Hiring Comic Artists, Writers & More
content:

author: factornotes
title: Hiring Illustrator for Stationery and Brand Campaigns
content:
We’re looking for a talented and detail-oriented Illustrator to join our team and create original artwork for our stationery collections and brand campaigns.
What You’ll Do: Create original illustrations and artwork for stationery, planners, product collections and brand campaigns. Develop creative concepts, patterns, characters.
Who You Are: 0–3 years of experience, proficient in Adobe Illustrator and Procreate, strong understanding of colour theory and composition.
Mail your resume and portfolio to: careers@factornotes.com

author: young.onion
title: Hiring Kawaii Artists for Stationery Collection
content:
🎨 WE ARE HIRING KAWAII ARTISTS! ✨
We are on the lookout for talented artists to bring their kawaii magic to our upcoming stationery collection!
How to apply: Follow us @young.onion, send DM with portfolio or fill application form in bio, or mail info@youngonion.in
If you love drawing chubby characters, happy little stationery, and sweet pastel doodles, we want to see your work!
